headline: Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII) Stock Could Be 33% Undervalued Following New Submarine Contracts
summary: Huntington Ingalls Industries stock has delivered a 77.0% return over the last five years, yet both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples still point to the shares trading at a discount to what the business may be worth. That combination puts the recent share price near US$326 into focus for investors who care about what they are paying for each dollar of future cash flow. A 77.0% five year return suggests long term holders have already been rewarded...
